definitions.explanation: Produced or manufactured in a foreign country; of foreign origin.

examples.japanese: これは{外国産|がいこくさん}の{果物|くだもの}です。
{外国産|がいこくさん}の{車|くるま}は{高|たか}いことが{多|おお}い。
{国産|こくさん}と{外国産|がいこくさん}、どちらがいいですか。
examples.english: Which is better, domestic or foreign-made?

notes:
{外国産|がいこくさん} combines {外国|がいこく} (foreign country) + {産|さん} (production/origin).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外国産|がいこくさん}の + noun (foreign-made ~)
- {外国産|がいこくさん}か{国産|こくさん}か (foreign or domestic)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {国産|こくさん} (domestic, made in Japan) - antonym
- ～{産|さん} suffix for origin: {中国産|ちゅうごくさん}, {米国産|べいこくさん}
- {輸入品|ゆにゅうひん} (imported goods)

USAGE NOTES:
- Common in food labeling and product descriptions
- Often contrasted with {国産|こくさん} (domestic)
